# Bakasana

> Bakasana is a mobile yoga practice companion for iPhone and Android, built to help people practice consistently, track progress, and see their transformation over time.

Bakasana is not a web trainer, not a sequence builder, and not an app for a single pose. Practice happens in the app. This website explains the product, the practice approach, and support.

Brand line: Build a yoga practice you want to return to.
Closing line: Find your balance. Return to practice.

The app includes four programs — Bakasana (balance), Plank (strength), Shavasana (recovery), and Flow (free-form movement) — plus guided sessions, streaks, progress tracking, and a private on-device Practice Timeline.

## English

- [Home](https://bakasana.app/): Product overview, four programs, Practice Timeline, FAQ, and download links
- [About](https://bakasana.app/about/): Why Bakasana exists and how yoga trainer Alena Tkacheva shapes the practice approach
- [Guides](https://bakasana.app/guides/): Practical reading on yoga practice, body awareness, progress, and healthy habits
- [Bakasana Is Foundational—and Here’s Why](https://bakasana.app/guides/bakasana-is-foundational-and-here-is-why/): What crane pose develops, why it can feel difficult, and how regular practice builds strength, balance, and body awareness
- [Support](https://bakasana.app/support/): Help with the app, accounts, programs, reminders, and Practice Timeline
- [Privacy Policy](https://bakasana.app/privacy/): How Bakasana collects, uses, stores, and protects information
